title: BPW-2026-0502
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0502
CD ALL
The Mayor has approved and authorized the Board of Public Works, on behalf of the Bureau of Street Services, to execute a five-year contract with Sterndahl Enterprises, LLC and Statewide Traffic Safety and Signs, Inc. to perform as-needed freeway off-ramp closure services.
(REF: BPW-2026-0268)
